items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: but I didn't get a chance to go up there and see him

ctx.x: You know, Eddie Pearson is sick. Supposed to be in charity last time.

Yeah, well, he's still in there. Yeah, that's true. Mm-hmm. Matter of fact, I played over there Friday, Friday evening at a charity. Mm-hmm. And, uh, but I didn't get a chance to go up there and see him, because I had to, I had to work out at the country club Friday night, and when we left there, it was late. So I had to rush home and get me something to eat, and then change clothes, and go pick up my brother, and rush out to the country club.
I wanted to ask you, who were some of the best clarinet players in New Orleans when you first came here?
